claims.text: The single RE2 model achieves an accuracy of 88.9% on the SNLI test set.
The ensemble RE2 model achieves an accuracy of 89.9% on the SNLI test set.
The RE2 model achieves an accuracy of 86.0% on the SciTail test set.
The RE2 model achieves an accuracy of 89.2% on the Quora Question Pairs test set.
The RE2 model achieves a MAP score of 0.7452 on the WikiQA test set.
The RE2 model achieves an MRR score of 0.7618 on the WikiQA test set.
The CPU inference speed of RE2 with 3 blocks is 6 times faster than CSRAN for a batch size of 8.
The CPU inference speed of RE2 with 3 blocks is at least 17 times faster than DIIN for a batch size of 8.
RE2 uses augmented residual connections to integrate original point-wise features, previous aligned features, and contextual features across stacked blocks.

evidence.description: Table 1 lists RE2 (ours) accuracy as 88.9±0.1 on the SNLI test set.
Table 1 lists RE2 (ensemble) accuracy as 89.9 on the SNLI test set.
Table 2 lists RE2 (ours) accuracy as 86.0±0.6 on the SciTail test set.
Table 3 lists RE2 (ours) accuracy as 89.2±0.2 on the Quora test set.
Table 4 lists RE2 (ours) MAP as 0.7452 ±0.0044 on the WikiQA test set.
Table 4 lists RE2 (ours) MRR as 0.7618 ±0.0040 on the WikiQA test set.
Table 5 reports RE2 (3 blocks) taking 0.05 s/batch compared to CSRAN taking 0.28 s/batch on Intel Core i7 CPUs.
Table 5 reports RE2 (3 blocks) taking 0.05 s/batch compared to DIIN taking 0.85 s/batch (and 1.79 s/batch with EM feature) on Intel Core i7 CPUs.
Section 2.1 describes formulation x_i^(n) = [x_i^(1); o_i^(n-1) + o_i^(n-2)] connecting blocks and maintaining embedding, residual, and encoded vectors.

methodologies.name: RE2 Architecture
methodologies.description: A neural text matching architecture composed of embedding, encoding, alignment, fusion, pooling, and prediction layers connected by augmented residual connections across N consecutive blocks.
conditions: Vanilla multi-layer convolutional networks with kernel size 3 as encoders
Adam optimizer with exponentially decaying learning rate and linear warmup
Intel Core i7 CPU for inference speed benchmark

limitations.text: Deeper stacked architectures in prior work suffer from inefficient propagation of lower-level features and vanishing gradients, making them harder to train.
On the WikiQA dataset, the proposed method is not robust to structural hyperparameter changes and exhibits high performance variance across random seeds.

future_work.text: Further investigation of the high performance variance on the WikiQA dataset.
